name: MemoVision
summary:
One thousand levels. Ten worlds. One board at a time — can you hold it all in your head?

MemoVision is the classic card-matching game, pushed a long way past flipping pairs. Every board opens with a preview. Then the cards turn over, and it is just you and what you managed to keep.

WHAT YOU'LL PLAY
• 1,000 levels across ten worlds, 100 in each
• Boards that grow from a gentle 2×2 to 42-card grids under a clock
• Hundreds of hand-drawn cards: farm animals, forest, ocean, desert, savannah, tundra, jungle, v
